```{r}

movies_data <- read.csv("movies.csv")

head(movies_data)


#This  is just to remove the commas and any other non-numeric stuff from the Number.of.Theaters variable
movies_data$Number.of.Theaters <- gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", movies_data$Number.of.Theaters)

movies_data$Number.of.Theaters <- as.numeric()

```
